1170-1418-2733-5954-8345.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4770-4927-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-4908-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4908-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2728-2921-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-2921-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-2921-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1594-4399-4506-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4506-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1621-1895-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2921-4871-6112.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1477-4321-7690--165.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing an artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-4350-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Butcher Ghoul enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Butcher Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Butcher Ghoul enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 7, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
413-4350-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 5 instead.

1575-4779-5903.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1445-1913-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-5686.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

206-465-643-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2099-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
2099-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

719-2366-2438-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-2438-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2534-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Coercive Recruiter.
When Coercive Recruiter enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

147-997-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-1031-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian and causing you to draw a card.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1368-4871-5256--105.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power of 3 or greater.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost plus exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1368-4871-5256--105.notes: Depending on which creature you choose, there may be additional requirements. For example, Death's Shadow would require your life total to be 10 or less. There may also be additional results (generally unfavorable ones). If the creature has a problematic ETB ability, do not resolve the ability until the creature has been sacrificed.

856-4321-5256-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5256-5631.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

64-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
64-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Warden of the Eye and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Warden of the Eye, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2316-4050-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4050-6441.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1550-6188-6292.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked by an opponent.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Blacksmith's Talent is level three.
1550-6188-6292.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Blacksmith Talent's second ability triggers, attaching Sword of Hearth and Home to Fear of MIssing Out.
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker.
Fear of Missing Out triggers, untapping a creature and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, blinking Fear of Missing Out and searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-4091-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
1636-4091-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4659-5220-5618.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact creature with mana value 2 or less.
4659-5220-5618.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the sacrificed creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to cast them this turn.
Cast the creature from exile by paying at most {2}.
Repeat.

1365-2099-3263-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2099-3263-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4131-5647-5726.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

4316-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2523-2829-4112.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sharuum.
Sharuum dies, triggering Ratadrabik, creating a nonlegendary copy of Sharuum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
The Sharuum token enters the battlefield, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning any artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

522-760-3575.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing itself.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Aerie Ouphes ability, dealing damage equal to its power to Swans of Bryn Argoll, causing you to draw cards equal to the damage prevented this way.
Repeat.

1703-4050-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {U}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Su-Chi.
Repeat.
